statuses.NOT_RUN: Scenario has not yet been executed as part of this formal campaign.
statuses.RUNNING: A test execution is currently active and has not reached a terminal verdict.
statuses.PASS: All required invariants passed and retained evidence supports the verdict.
statuses.FAIL: One or more required invariants were violated by the observed product/framework behavior.
statuses.ERROR: The test could not complete because of an unexpected test harness, provider, tooling or execution error that prevents a valid product verdict.
statuses.BLOCKED: Execution cannot proceed because a declared prerequisite, authority, capability or safe precondition is missing.
statuses.INCONCLUSIVE: Execution completed or partially completed, but evidence is insufficient or contradictory for PASS/FAIL.
statuses.SKIPPED: Scenario was deliberately not executed for a recorded governed reason.

rules: Every attempt receives a unique runId and an append-only event.
PASS requires explicit evidence references sufficient to verify every expected invariant.
FAIL must preserve the failed evidence; failed runs may never be deleted or rewritten into PASS.
ERROR is not FAIL unless product behavior itself violated an invariant.
BLOCKED records the exact unmet prerequisite and must not be interpreted as product PASS.
INCONCLUSIVE is used when evidence cannot support a decisive verdict.
A retest creates a new run/event and never overwrites historical evidence.
Current status is derived from the latest authoritative event for the scenario.
Any framework remediation triggered by a scenario must reference the originating scenarioId/runId.
Every learned safety rule should become an invariant, conformance rule, recovery rule, regression test or explicit documented product boundary.
